titulo_fr: Une étiquette de produit : Observer les formes
titulo_es: A product label: Vocabulary and shapes
intro: It interprets quantities, prices and basic data of a label. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It interprets quantities, prices and basic data of a label. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention: Units such as « g », « kg » and « ml » complete the product name; « par » expresses the unit price. In this fragment, «farine» means «flour».

frases.en: The price is two euros with fifty per package.

frases.es: La harina viene de un molino cerca de la ciudad.
frases.en: The flour comes from a mill near the city.
